svg.title: Direction dependence of the lattice phase speed
svg.desc: Left: phase speed relative to the continuum against propagation angle for the five-point and nine-point Laplacians. Right: the spread between the axis and diagonal directions against wavelength, which falls as the second power of the wavenumber for five points and the fourth for nine.
svg.text: Why nine points: the error is the same in every direction
Courant number 0.5. Angle 0 is along a grid axis, 45 degrees along a diagonal.
propagation angle (degrees from a grid axis)
axis minus diagonal speed (percent of c)
Dashed guides are k^2 and k^4 through the 60-cell end. Along an axis both stencils have the same symbol (2 - 2 cos k); only the diagonal differs.
Taylor series: 5-point symbol = k^2 - (kx^4 + ky^4)/12; 9-point symbol = k^2 - k^4/12, isotropic to fourth order.
